summary: Post-approval race condition: UI shows access granted for Model Insights but 403 persists
description:
Issue summary:
Several internal users report that the Model Insights app shows their access request as "Approved" in the self-service UI, but they receive 403 Forbidden when loading dashboards or running queries. This started being reported after the cross-region IdP rollout last week.

Impact:
- Affects internal analytics and platform engineers using Model Insights (approx 12 confirmed users across teams).
- Blocks debugging and incident work for these users when they don't actually get role bindings despite the UI state: 'Granted'.
- Intermittent: ~20% of approvals processed in the last 48h ended up in this state.

First observed:
2026-03-11 09:40 UTC in us-east region after a staged Okta tenant update and scaled approval queue processing.

Additional context:
- Model Insights uses the standard access-request flow: approval -> webhook to provisioning service -> RBAC service creates role_binding -> auth-proxy cache pick-up -> user can access.
- After the Okta change there were duplicated approval webhook deliveries (same approval id delivered twice to different regional endpoints). The UI shows a successful approval acknowledgment but the downstream RBAC binding sometimes lacks the internal role_id mapping required by auth-proxy.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Submit an access request for Model Insights from internal console for a user in us-east.
2) Approve the request via the approval queue (canary approver account used).

3) Observe approval webhook delivery logs in provisioning service. If duplicate webhook deliveries occur across regions, sometimes role_binding created with missing role_id mapping or created before role mapping reconciliation completes.
4) User refreshes Model Insights; UI shows "Granted" but request to /v1/dashboards returns 403 with X-Auth-Reason header 'role-mapping-missing'.
logs:
2026-03-11T09:42:12Z provisioning-service INFO Received approval id=appr-9c1f
2026-03-11T09:42:13Z provisioning-service WARN Duplicate approval id=appr-9c1f delivered to regional endpoint us-west while us-east still processing
2026-03-11T09:42:13Z rbac-service ERROR create_role_binding failed: missing_internal_role_id for external_role='model_insights_viewer' request_id=req-77f
2026-03-11T09:42:14Z auth-proxy DEBUG cache-refresh skipped: no mapping for role_binding rb-443
2026-03-11T09:42:15Z model-insights ERROR /api/dashboards 403 user=alice@example.com reason=role-mapping-missing
investigation_notes:
Initial triage by Support and SRE: 
- Confirmed duplicate webhook deliveries originating from the approval queue fanout to regional provisioning endpoints.
- Observed a time window where the SCIM/role-mapping table (role_mappings) is being asynchronously reconciled after an Okta canonicalization change; if provisioning creates a binding before reconciliation completes, role_binding.row.role_id stays NULL and auth-proxy rejects requests.
- The provisioning service does not currently provide a strong idempotency guarantee across regions; duplicate deliveries can race with background reconciliation jobs.
- Auth-proxy relies on role_id (internal numeric id) instead of external_role slug; missing role_id causes 403 with 'role-mapping-missing'.

Hypothesis: missing idempotency / race between regional webhook processing and background role mapping reconciliation after the IdP attribute normalization change.

Data points:
- 12 affected users all had access requests processed within a 10s window of the SCIM reconciliation job run.
- When we manually re-bound the role_binding (populate role_id and re-send cache invalidation), users immediately regained access.

Temporary mitigation executed:
- Added a short retry+reconcile step in provisioning service for pending bindings (backfill job) scoped to last 1 hour which fixed ~8/12 cases so far.
- Added alert rule to detect create_role_binding failures with 'missing_internal_role_id' and to escalate to SRE.
comments: Support (Aisha): Added initial report and reproducer; collected affected user list and first set of logs.
SRE (Samir): Investigating provisioning fanout. Found duplicate webhook deliveries between us-east and us-west; suspect idempotency key not set on regional fanout.

Eng (Priya, SCIM): We rolled Okta canonicalization patch 2026-03-10 that introduced a delayed reconciliation job to normalize external_role slugs. We will prioritize making reconciliation synchronous for new role definitions or add blocking to provisioning until mappings exist.
SRE (Samir): Applied a temporary backfill to populate missing role_id for affected role_bindings and triggered auth-proxy cache invalidation for those user sessions (recovered 8/12).
Support (Aisha): Notified affected users and asked for verification; two users still report 403 after backfill.

Eng (Priya): For the remaining users, found a separate code path that writes role_binding before creating the external_role row in the role_mappings table due to a rare migration ordering issue. Preparing fix PR to enforce transactional create-or-wait semantics.
resolution:
Workaround in place: manual backfill job and cache invalidation restores access for most users. Next steps (in progress):
- Engineering to land PR that adds region-safe idempotency keys to the approval webhook fanout (expected 2026-03-15).
- Change provisioning service to block short-lived bindings until role_mappings confirms existence (or perform an inline reconciliation).
- Add a reconcile-and-retry step to provisioning for 30s with exponential backoff to reduce races.
- Post-deploy: run a one-off audit to find any stale bindings with NULL role_id and fix.
- Add monitoring: metric 'rbac.bindings.missing_role_id' and alert threshold > 1/min.

Pending: final fix PR, QA on canary region, and a postmortem to be filed on Confluence.
